_doc: Recipe per transformers model_type: LoRA target modules and the precision of the paper recipe. `fp16_amp` = fp32 weights with fp16 autocast (torch_dtype float32); `bf16` = bf16 weights with bf16 autocast. `attn_implementation` is the attention of the training forward under mixed precision (flash kernels need fp16 / bf16; the selection forward is fp32 and uses `selection_attn_implementation`). Model types that are not listed use `default`.
